About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Role summary

The Senior Manager, GTM FP&A is the finance business partner to the Customer Experience (CX) organization, covering all four teams: Customer Success, Professional Services, Renewals, and Support. The role owns forecasting, planning, install-base economics, and retention (GRR/NRR) analytics for these teams, and turns the numbers into a clear narrative for CX leadership, QBRs, and board content. It is a hands-on individual contributor role that works closely with Sales Ops, Strategic Finance, and the broader FP&A team, and partners with the Center of Excellence (CoE) on organizational spend planning.

What you will do

  • Own the CX forecast. Build bottoms-up forecasts for renewals bookings and GRR/NRR, along with Professional Services and Support revenue and cost. Reconcile to CRM data and flag risks and upside to leadership.

  • Lead quarterly results reporting. Own the CX results commentary for QBRs and board content, and explain variances against plan and prior forecast.

  • Drive renewals and retention analytics. Track gross and net retention, churn and contraction drivers, price-uplift realization, and expansion attainment. Partner with Customer Success and Renewals on at-risk book reviews.

  • Measure Customer Success performance. Analyze CSM productivity, book-of-business coverage, account segmentation, and coverage models, and tie them to retention outcomes.

  • Support Professional Services and Support economics. Track services bookings, backlog, utilization, and margin, and analyze Support capacity, headcount, and cost to serve as the install base grows.

  • Drive the platform migration program. Build the financial framework for platform migration, track leading indicators, and report progress against plan.

  • Lead strategic planning. Develop forward-looking analytical frameworks that size growth opportunities across the install base and lay out the path to unlock them. Build the CX targets that roll up to the annual and long-range plan.

  • Manage spend planning. Partner with the CoE on headcount, T&E, and discretionary spend for the CX organization, and meet regularly with leaders on budget vs. actuals.

  • Provide decision support. Lead pricing, packaging, and segmentation analyses for install-base motions, and contribute, with Strategic Finance, to decisions on coverage models, compensation planning, and resource allocation.

  • Protect data and definitions. Partner with Sales Ops and Strategic Finance to apply consistent definitions for ARR, bookings, GRR, NRR, and churn across all CX reporting.

  • Partner across Finance. Work closely with Sales Ops, Strategic Finance, and the broader FP&A team to keep CX plans, forecasts, and reporting aligned with company-wide numbers.

We’d Love to See:

  • 8–12 years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, including 3+ years supporting GTM organization at a SaaS or cybersecurity company.

  • Track record building forecasting and retention analytics frameworks at $500M+ ARR scale; IPO or pre-IPO experience preferred.

  • Deep knowledge of SaaS and install-base metrics: ARR, bookings, GRR, NRR, churn, expansion, and services margin.

  • Experience supporting Professional Services and Support finance, including utilization, backlog, and cost to serve, is a plus.

  • Strong financial modeling skills, including forecasting, scenario, and retention models.

  • Strong systems fluency, including NetSuite, Salesforce, and Adaptive or Anaplan, with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

  • Ability to translate complex data into an executive-ready narrative for CX and board audiences.

  • Track record of strong cross-functional partnerships with Sales Ops, Strategic Finance, and business leaders, with a hands-on approach.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field; MBA or CPA a plus.

For this Job, Delinea is not considering candidates that need any type of US work authorization now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J1, etc.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.
